questions.stem: Fleming's right-hand rule is used to determine the direction of:

options.text: Force on a current-carrying wire in a magnetic field
Induced current in a conductor moving through a magnetic field
Current flow in a battery circuit

questions.explanation: Fleming's right-hand rule is used for generators and electromagnetic induction -- it gives the direction of the induced current when a conductor moves through a magnetic field. Fleming's left-hand rule is used for motors (the motor effect).
